work equipment, which includes industrial pallet racking, cask storage frames
and archive shelving, is maintained in an efficient state, in efficient working
order and in good repair. The Health and Safety Executive (HSE) stipulates that

injury, HSE inspectors can bring criminal prosecutions that expose company
directors to personal legal liability, unlimited fines and custodial sentences.
